note: Public graded record by card and by leg type. Record counts the first-posted card. Starting November 15, the featured parlay is Deep Floor, capped at 3 legs by Floor Score, with NBA threes left out. Its record before November 15 is a backtest: the rule applied to earlier posted cards. The November 14 model ticket is graded from the morning card; Jamal Murray Over 2.5 threes was a loss, and a later swap to rebounds is not counted. Sleeper flags: next-man-up backups tagged Sleeper, graded on a modest box-score floor once the game is final (NFL skill 25 rec / 30 rush yards, NBA 8+ points, NHL 1+ point). Contrarian tags: injury or rest news that cuts against the side with at least 10 points more of the traded action; a hit means that busy side lost. Floor Score, calibrated chance and these flags are estimates. Not betting advice. Sample sizes are still small.
